verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a full REST API, JavaScript SDK, and static API-key auth (sumup-docs-13, sumup-docs-14, sumup-docs-27) plus a sandbox environment for scripted testing of checkouts and payment flows (sumup-docs-1, sumup-docs-17), all of which support headless, non-interactive invocation suitable for CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, GitHub Actions example, or documented automated test-suite workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, example pipeline configs, and independent confirmation of headless test runs in CI.
